truths.truth: With the 8088 lane down, credentials refused or /config unread, the six engine writes each answer a refusal and the fake 4321 receives no command
truths.evidence: hqptuner/api/readygate.py:62-101 (decide holds every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE under /api outside OPEN_WRITES; ReadyGate answers refusal(manager) without calling the app while manager.ready is false); installed at hqptuner/api/factory.py:78 before LoginGate. ready = connected and readings.http_ok (hqptuner/core/manager.py:153), http_ok false with no client or any config_error (hqptuner/core/loader.py:123); AuthRefused is an httpx.HTTPError so a refused pair records config_error (hqptuner/lanes/http/forms.py:84-86). tests/api/surface/test_writes_refused_not_ready.py passes (6 routes x 3 causes, plus restart window). Its silence case is only a relation (fewer commands than when ready), so a spot-check instrumented Lanes.commands_sent_by in that test: while ready the routes sent 3/2/14/2/0/3 commands; after each of 8088-down, credentials-refused and config-unread every one of the six answered 502 daemon_read_failed or 503 no_credentials with cmds=0 and an empty command log slice.

truths.truth: Server-started engine writes (auto-pilot junk-filter move, LIVE re-assert on a chain change) send nothing while not ready and act once ready returns
truths.evidence: hqptuner/core/autopilotops.py:50 returns early unless mgr.ready; hqptuner/lanes/live/lane.py:185-188 keeps reassert_pending while not ready and re-asserts only when ready. tests/live/test_background_writes_wait.py passed in the targeted run (exit=0). hqptuner/core/junkcal.py:3-5 is the only other lifespan task and writes files only.

truths.truth: In that state the 4321 reads are answered by their own routes, not the gate, and return within their deadline when the fake 4321 stalls
truths.evidence: decide() passes every GET/HEAD (readygate.py:70-71); loader.poll keeps querying 4321 (State, Status, VolumeRange, profiles) with no readiness check (hqptuner/core/loader.py:150-190), so the snapshot reads are still attempted. tests/api/surface/test_not_ready_reads.py passes: seven reads answer their own route's status with 8088 down; six take less than cfg.request_timeout on the silent virtual clock with every 4321 query stalled; /api/log is held to 'answered' (502 from its own 8088 read) on the ordinary clock, since the silent clock runs its 8088 deadline out too (plan-4 report open item 4).

truths.truth: Every builder in tests/support and tests/conftest.py starts both lanes with the 8088 forms loaded, except unserved_login, and no test asserts a feature succeeding with 8088 down
